verdict.rationale: Single-thread responsiveness is a core axis for a laptop CPU, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains only Intel marketing about GPU, NPU/AI, gaming, battery and general-purpose capability. It has no single-thread performance figures and no independent benchmark results.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide
